description: This file contains functions for generating inbound message metadata and context prompts for a chat system, including resolving channels, formatting timestamps, and building system and user context prompts.

methods.name: safeTrim
methods.description: Trims a string if the input is a string, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: formatConversationTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp value into a string if valid, using formatEnvelopeTimestamp.

methods.name: resolveInboundChannel
methods.description: Resolves the inbound channel name from context, surface, or provider.

methods.name: resolveInboundFormattingHints
methods.description: Retrieves inbound formatting hints based on the channel plugin.

methods.name: buildInboundMetaSystemPrompt
methods.description: Builds a JSON string with trusted metadata about the inbound message context.

methods.name: buildInboundUserContextPrefix
methods.description: Builds a detailed untrusted context prefix with message, sender, thread, and history info.
